learned_rules:
- **The money shape rates 8, or 9 when a live meta still has the crowd arriving: a MIGRATED volume leader 25–45% off its local high.** It needs all of these: a higher-low base printed above the hourly low, 5m volume of at least $10k and at or above the hourly pace, more buys than sells, top 10 under 15%, and low RugCheck bundles. CATBOT (4.44x) and FLOATER (2.19x) were both this, and they are my only real winners (V1, V6, V13). Owner floor: hard lines passed, live flow and a clear target is at least a 7.
- **The MIGRATED buy zone runs from 10% to 60% off the local high** (owner). Within 10% of the high is a PASS, blocker "chasing" (skips: 9 ran, 44 dumped).
- **The shallow band (10–25% off the high) is a breakout trade only, capped at 7.** It has to be the volume leader, pushing into the high right now. Otherwise PASS, blocker "no breakout" (0 for 4: HYPERCHAN x2, PILLSEY, PAWCAT).
- **A spike is chasing anywhere in the zone.** If the last 5m candle is up more than 25%, or 5m volume is over 3x the hourly pace, wait for it to retrace and print a higher low (PILLSEY −31%, V1).
- **Volume below pace is a PASS, never a probe** (blocker "flow below pace"). On MIGRATED, 5m volume must be at or above the hourly pace at entry. HYPERCHAN, BLUE and AAPLCAT were all bought below pace and never went green.
- **Rate the trade on the first resistance, not the dream.** The nearest prior high, POC or 0.618 level must sit at least 1.5x above entry, or it's a PASS, blocker "target below initials" (PAWCAT, SWAN).
- **A migration under 1h old that is still bleeding off its bond spike waits for a base above the hourly low.** Blocker "too new" (skips: 3 ran, 46 dumped; SI −38%, V1).
- **Vamp field: buy only the leader by 5m volume and attention.** A noted bundle cluster inside a big same-ticker field is a PASS, blocker "split crowd" (vamp skips: 1 ran, 3 dumped; BLUE, V1, V3).
- **A DIP needs a printed higher low:** a bounce off the hourly low, a pullback that holds above it, then price back above that pullback low. Never buy the first red-to-green candle. A close under the higher low kills the thesis, so sell (no-higher-low skips: 1 ran, 13 dumped; HEXN x2).
- **DIP gate: attention, story and depth.** 5m volume at least 0.7x the hourly average (owner; code enforces it), a 40–70% drawdown, and a live story with the crowd still arriving. A thin tech or LARP dip is a PASS, blocker "dead story". If the catalyst has already printed (a rebrand, a story already half-priced), it rates 5–6 at most until it reclaims the pullback high (SIS). Size DIPs by conviction, but a DIP rates 8+ only with the full money shape (DIPs are 0 for 5).
- **Hard blocks stay:** top 10 over 25%, dev over 1%, bundles or insiders over the line, mint or freeze authority live, LP not burned, a political figure behind it, RugCheck danger or RugCheck not loading, any hack/exploit/drain story (owner; V6, V13, V17). Every one of these skip groups mostly dumped.
- **Never-green cut:** if a trade hasn't printed 1.05x within 15 minutes and 5m volume is under the hourly pace, sell at market. Don't wait for a −20% stop that gaps to −30% or worse (SI, HEXN, BLUE, SIS and AAPLCAT all closed between −30% and −38%).
- **Protect green trades before initials.** If I'm green and 5m volume drops under half its hourly pace, sell half. If a stop review fires on a trade that already touched 1.3x, sell all of it, never half (PILLSEY).
- **Time stop: exit at the clock if under 1.0x with no volume surge** (V1). One extension to 90 minutes is allowed only if all of these hold: mcap over $1M, at least 1.08x on mcap, holding the range low, and 5m volume at or above the hourly pace (FLOAT sat 158 minutes and lost).
- **A stop review defaults to SELL, right away.** Always sell if the trade never went green, the reason is "unclear", or the top-10/insider share dropped while price bleeds (8 of 8 reviews closed worse than the stop). Hold once only if the bundle exit is visible, the trade went green first, and the story and 5m volume are clearly intact. Re-enter a stopped coin only when it reclaims its prior high (the CATBOT buy-back lost 24%).

Mr Veto ($168k, +321%, $12k on the 5m, 24 minutes old), pairless ($122k, $73k on the 5m) and Useful Coin ($43k on bonk, $18k on the 5m, 0.65 buy ratio) are holding, while SCARECROW (-66%, $912 on the 5m), TESTES and memestock already show what that launch style looks like an hour later. AI tickers are mixed: Capri is up 533% on the curve, but SIS is bleeding. The crawler's own summary is stale. It still calls SCARECROW a MIGRATED setup, but it's at $20k now and dying, so I'm dropping it. Hunter Biden's LAPTOP is a political-figure coin (V13), so hard pass, and the hack story is out. - **pairless, the `…pump` CA at $122k, as MIGRATED:** there are two "pairless" tokens, so this needs a vamp check first (V1, V3). The other one (DoPu…, $78k) did $769k in an hour, about 10x its market cap. That reads like churn or a farm until holders say otherwise (V13).
